name: pr-review-mcp
description: Review GitHub Pull Requests and explore repository structures with Claude. Fetches PR context, repository files, validates findings, and optionally submits structured code reviews.
long_description:
An MCP server that gives Claude the ability to retrieve GitHub pull requests, explore repository trees, and submit structured code reviews.

**Claude does the AI reasoning. The MCP server does the GitHub plumbing.**

## Tools

- `review_pull_request` — Fetches and normalises a GitHub PR into a structured context for Claude to review.
- `get_repository_context` — Explores a repository's structure (Git tree and metadata).
- `get_repository_file` — Retrieves the content of specific files in the repository.
- `submit_pr_review` — Validates Claude's findings against the actual PR diff and optionally submits a GitHub review.

## Requirements

- Python 3.10+ with `mcp`, `httpx`, `pydantic`, and `python-dotenv` installed.
- A GitHub fine-grained PAT with Contents (read) and Pull requests (read + write) permissions.

tools.name: review_pull_request
tools.description: Retrieve and normalise a GitHub Pull Request for Claude to review. Read-only. Returns PRContext with diffs, commits, and source content.

tools.name: get_repository_context
tools.description: Retrieve structured repository-level context for a GitHub repository. Returns the repository default branch, the commit SHA of the requested ref, and the complete Git tree.

tools.name: get_repository_file
tools.description: Retrieve the contents of a single file from a GitHub repository. Use this tool after exploring the repository structure with get_repository_context to fetch specific files of interest.

tools.name: submit_pr_review
tools.description: Validate Claude's ReviewResult and optionally submit a GitHub review. Use dry_run=true (default) for a safe preview with no GitHub mutation.

prompts.name: pr_review_rubric
prompts.description: The official engineering rubric for reviewing Pull Requests.

github_token.title: GitHub Token
github_token.description: A GitHub fine-grained personal access token. Required permissions: Contents (read), Pull requests (read + write). Create at https://github.com/settings/tokens?type=beta
